title: Hop
description: One 0.5 s (or 1.0 s under FB2) audio-visual hop sent from the browser to the backend and separation server.

session_id.description: Unique identifier for the live browser session.

seq.description: Monotonically increasing hop sequence number starting at 0.

target_face_id.description: ID of the current target face, or null if no face is currently visible.

reset.description: True on target switch so the separation server clears and refills its face buffer.

pcm.description: Base64-encoded 16 kHz mono little-endian int16 PCM audio (8000 samples = 16000 bytes for a 0.5 s hop).

crops.description: 12 or 13 base64-encoded 112x112 grayscale JPEG face crops of the target at 25 fps (ClearVoice crop recipe). May be empty if target is momentarily lost.

t_capture.description: Client wall-clock capture timestamp in Unix milliseconds when this hop finished collecting.

faces.description: Optional snapshot of all tracked faces in this hop for backend Decision 1, consent, and attribution.

other_crops.description: Optional per-face base64 JPEG crops for non-target visible faces (for Decision 1 speaking checks).

frame_jpeg.description: Optional base64 JPEG of the current video frame (with target box if requested) for Engine A fallback and Robot R1 pointing.
